signs.name: megumi
signs.howTo: Make a fist with each hand and hold them up in front of you, a little apart, knuckles toward the camera.

signs.name: sukuna
signs.howTo: Push one open palm out toward the camera, fingers spread, while the other hand stays back in a raised fist.

signs.name: yuta
signs.howTo: Hold one flat palm up facing the camera with the fingers together, and keep the other hand in a fist low at your chest.

signs.name: gojo
signs.howTo: Bring both hands together in front of you and cross the fingers of one hand through the other.

signs.name: malevolent_shrine
signs.howTo: Bring your hands together and interlock them closely, held upright in front of your chest.
